newsitem.title: NORWAY: NORDIC SKIING-DAEHLIE WINS SECOND GOLD.
newsitem.headline: NORDIC SKIING-DAEHLIE WINS SECOND GOLD.

text.p: Bjorn Daehlie of Norway won his second gold medal of the Nordic skiing world championships in Tuesday's 15-km freestyle pursuit cross-country race.
Daehlie, who had won Monday's first part of the pursuit event, the 10-km classical style, was in a class of his own again as he clocked a provisional winning time of 36 minutes 30.10 seconds.

Daehlie, who started 28 seconds before Russian Alexei Prokurorov and 33 seconds before Finn Myllylae, second and third respectively in Monday's race, steadily increased his lead as the race progressed.
A tense battle for second place ended with Myllylae outsprinting Prokurorov. The pair crossed the line more than 50 seconds after Daehlie.
